title: Hatsune Miku — Become The Understudy!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When are Emu and the others gonna get here...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be here soon.
We'll need to tell Tsukasa about filling in for him when they do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Filling in?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Rui asked me about having one of us to play Thorpe in Tsukasa's place so that the others can work on their lines.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which I suspect is going to be me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, like an understudy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, there they are! Miku! KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Heya☆
What brings all of you guys here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
There's something we'd like to ask you two!
Right, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. You're both supposed to practice with Emu and the others today, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is Tsukasa gonna be there with them?
It feels like it's been so long since we last met...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... Right now, Tsukasa's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So right now, Tsukasa's trying really, really, really hard to figure things out☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't realize he was working so hard on getting into character. That explains why we haven't seen him in so long...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I remember Rui saying something about Tsukasa not being a good fit for Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. But Tsukasa responded by saying, “I promise to do this role justice!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I'm sure he'll figure it out!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sure he will.
After all, this is Tsukasa we're talking about here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it's gotta be so hard being all on your own like this. Isn't there something we can do for him...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At the same time, Tsukasa needs to take care of this on his own if he wishes to grow as an actor.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure chatting with him is still okay, but we have to be more or less hands-off this time around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Especially since he wants to become a world-famous star! That means he's gonna have to learn to play all sorts of different roles!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Right...
I guess we should stay on the sidelines for this one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aww... You two seem so deflated now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin, Len!
Let's try getting into character too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The thing is, the others need someone to be Tsukasa's understudy♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO's probably the best pick...
But Tsukasa's trying his darndest to get through this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I think we should also try playing Thorpe!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that actually might be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As I mentioned earlier, we should probably be more hands-off when it comes to Tsukasa this time around.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, a quick chat can still go a long way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I think it'd be nice if we could all learn a little more about Thorpe just in case Tsukasa decided to stop by and ask us for some advice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think so too!
I know it won't be easy, but let's give it a try, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially if learning more about Thorpe means we'd be helping Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll help out too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we turn it into a little contest where the winner gets to be Tsukasa's understudy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds fun☆
There's no way I'm losing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me neither!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, let's go read through the script together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We're doing the same, Luka!
I'm going to need your help learning these lines!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's... Give it our... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She fell asleep?!
Hey, Luka, wake up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here we goooo!
I'm gonna try super extra hard too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As motivated as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because Tsukasa, Emu, Nene and Rui all seem like they're tangled up in knots right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. Tsukasa's having trouble playing his character, which is causing the others to worry about him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm like the exact opposite of Thorpe! Imagine if I somehow figure out how to play him! The others might think, “Wait, it's that easy?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which could become the motivation they need to try even harder and turn their frowns upside down!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you made this suggestion to cheer Rin and the others up...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I had no idea you were being this thoughtful. Again, Miku, you've come up with a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Woohoo! KAITO liked my idea♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, for everyone's sake, I'm gonna learn everything I can about Thorpe! Let's go!
